modules.module_title: Inspect the materials required for fabrication work

pcs.pc_description: read and interpret blueprints/ working drawings/shop drawings/ specification details related to the fabrication activities

identify different components/ sections like columns, I-beams, girders, trusses, channels, angles, plates, hollow section and other mild steel (MS) components/ accessories required in the steel fabrication work with respect to the specifications/ drawings

locate the appropriate sections based on sizes, dimensions, and design in the warehouse/ storing yard for further processing which may involve grinding, wielding, cutting, bending, drilling, punching, burning or melting
ensure that there are correct identity marks/heat number on the structural sections as per the organizational norms
confirm that quality inspection has been conducted by the quality department for the required materials
ensure the fabrication material has no physical damage like distortion, bending, cracks etc.
ensure that the materials are loaded, shifted and unloaded to the fabrication yard/ workshop safely, following standard practices

modules.module_title: Conduct surface cleaning of the sections for fabricating steel structures

pcs.pc_description: inspect the surface of the materials/ sections to determine the types of impurities on it
obtain approval for employing different methods of surface cleaning from the concerned authority
estimate the quantities of the materials required for the surface cleaning purpose
initiate indent procedures for the required cleaning materials as per the organizational norms
ensure appropriate surface cleaning procedures like heating, chemical cleaning, scrubbing, water jet, abrasion etc. are adopted as per the requirements/ instructions
confirm the compliance of prepared clean surface with technical details or instructions

modules.module_title: Conduct edge/ joint preparation and connection activities using welding and bolting methods

pcs.pc_description: identify the components/sections of the assemblies as per drawings or instructions
estimate the consumables, tools, equipment and manpower required for the edge/ joint preparation
inspect instruments, consumables, tools and equipment visually for their working conditions
customize suitable jigs and fixtures according to workpiece and clamp it to the bed of the platform for the smooth execution of work
perform calculations for computation of dimensions from drawings if required
measure and mark bending/cutting lines, drilling points etc. on the work piece/ sections within tolerance limits as per provided technical details/standard procedures
conduct necessary operations such as bending, cutting, drilling etc. in order to ensure precise orientation, alignments and fittings of the work piece/ section
conduct edge-preparation for the work piece/ section using Punch and Nibble method, Peeling and Shearing Method or Milling and Routing Method as per requirement
ensure that allowance for thickness, shrinkage and root gaps are maintained for the joints as per the standard practice and specifications
conduct connections of joints by weld/ bolt connection methods as per the specifications and drawings
ensure that joints/ connections of the different components of assemblies comply with the specifications and drawings
ensure joints are free of irregularities or impurities before further operations
arrange for inspection of the fabricated assemblies by superiors

modules.module_title: Conduct repair of fabricated components/ assemblies

pcs.pc_description: inspect the component/ assemblies for distortions/ errors in dimensions or other defects
identify the most suitable method for correcting the defects
estimate roughly the quantity and type of manpower, materials, consumables, tools, equipment and time required for completing the repair work
obtain approval from superiors for carrying out repairs with estimated resources
conduct the operations like grinding, welding, heating, jacking etc. as per the repair work requirement
recheck the repaired work prior to submitting the same for quality inspections
ensure that the tools and equipment are correctly used, maintained and stored

modules.module_title: Prepare for the erection of structural steel assemblies

pcs.pc_description: ensure that proper access to the erection site is available to both erection team and load lifting equipment/ machine
ensure that survey marks and reference points are available for the erection work
carry out necessary measurement and marking to ascertain the exact location of erection
ensure the availability of base plates or other level correction provisions are provided at the base of erection as per requirement
check the availability of provisions for bolting, welding, post-tensioning connections as per the drawing
ensure designed bearing area in the platform or support is available for efficient erection of the components

check for hazardous situations at erection site, such as the presence of live electrical cables, absence of proper barricading, excessive wind speed and report it to the concerned authority promptly as per requirement
check availability of all materials and support equipment (identified by the seniors and required to proceed with the work) and report any shortages

modules.module_title: Erect structural steel assemblies as per drawing

pcs.pc_description: install shoring, bracing and guying materials as directed by the foreman/ supervisor or specified by erection drawings and details considering local conditions
pull, push and hold suspended structural steel assemblies/ components approximately to their exact location by hand or suitable means during lowering of load
communicate efficiently to the signalman or operator for precise movements required to place the object/ assemblies at accurate location
ensure units are guided to their appropriate locations
place the steel assemblies/ components to its accurate location efficiently and make required adjustments as per erection requirement
ensure proper orientation and alignment of the erected steel assembly/ component by carrying out required measurement and checks using appropriate measuring tools and instruments
check installation of temporary connections using appropriate tools prior to final positioning of precast units/ steel assemblies for their stability
bolt connections to the specified tolerance and torque using appropriate torque wrench wherever required
check bolt tightness in case of units having slotted connections
install special steel washers to ensure that the specified tension has been developed in the bolt
check location of shims, bearing pads for their proper positioning
install expansion bolts using prescribed installation procedures and quality control specifications

modules.module_title: Follow safety norms as defined by the organization

pcs.pc_description: identify and report any hazards, risks or breaches in site safety to the appropriate authority

identify near miss, unsafe condition and unsafe act

use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per work requirements for : Head Protection, Ear protection, Fall Protection ,Foot Protection, Face and Eye Protection, Hand and Body Protection , and Respiratory Protection (if required)
